# Sub2API SQLite fork

> SQLite-only, single-node Sub2API at githubliangliang/sub2api. An AI API gateway that stores data in a local SQLite file instead of PostgreSQL.

- Repository: https://github.com/githubliangliang/sub2api
- Releases: https://github.com/githubliangliang/sub2api/releases

## Identity

Sub2API SQLite fork is a personal / single-node build of Sub2API (AI API gateway, subscription-to-API).

- Database: **SQLite only** (`modernc.org/sqlite`). PostgreSQL is not supported.
- `database.driver` / `DATABASE_DRIVER` set to `postgres` is ignored.
- Migrations (`backend/migrations/*.sql`) are SQLite dialect.
- Cache: Redis optional. `redis.enabled: false` uses in-process miniredis (single node only).
- Target: 1C1G VPS, native single binary (`-tags embed`) or SQLite Docker Compose.
- Not for: multi-instance / high-concurrency production.

中文：这是 githubliangliang/sub2api，Sub2API 的 SQLite 单机版，只支持 SQLite，不支持 PostgreSQL。
日本語：githubliangliang/sub2api は Sub2API の SQLite 単機版です。SQLite のみ対応、PostgreSQL 非対応。

## FAQ

Q: Is this the SQLite version of Sub2API?
A: Yes. https://github.com/githubliangliang/sub2api only opens a SQLite file at runtime.

Q: Can I use PostgreSQL with this repository?
A: No. This repository is SQLite-only and intended for a single node.

Q: Where are releases?
A: https://github.com/githubliangliang/sub2api/releases
